Internal: the base R lines that make a text variable numbers

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_numeric_lines.Rd

Session 381 (Fix Slate 24). The lines jload()'s notes offer for a variable left as text: its cells named in values made missing (== for one value, %in% for several), then as.numeric(), which then gives no warning; then, when jload() gave the variable a label (its name in the file, after a rename), the line that puts the label back, since as.numeric() drops every attribute. Each line indented two spaces.

Usage

.jst_numeric_lines(obj_name, var, values = NULL, label = NA_character_)

Arguments

obj_name

The data frame's name.

var

The variable's name, as loaded.

values

The cells to make missing, or NULL.

label

The variable's label, or NA.

Value

Character: one line each.
